final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_minus_gpu FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_group_storage FROM grouped), results AS (SELECT grouped.*, avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(mean_group_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM grouped CROSS JOIN overall WHERE mean_group_storage IS NOT NULL) SELECT site_code, insurance_status, avg_remaining_storage, avg_cpu_minus_gpu, storage_ratio FROM results ORDER BY storage_ratio IS NULL, storage_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
